_comment: Prefer registering with the CLI over hand-merging, so the token never lands in a synced config file: claude mcp add --transport http alfred-vault http://benderman.<tailnet>.ts.net:8765/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $ALFRED_HTTP_TOKEN" -s user
_transport: streamable-http mounted at /mcp — NOT sse at /sse. This file used to say sse, which silently fails to connect.
_host: Use the MagicDNS name, never a literal 100.x/192.168.x address. This file previously hardcoded 192.168.254.182, an address the desktop no longer has — that stale IP is why laptop access quietly stopped working.
_auth: The desktop requires a Bearer token (~/.config/alfred/http-token.env, 0600). Copy it out-of-band; never commit it.
_meta_server: The cross-vault 'alfred' meta server is stdio-only. Reach it by wrapping stdio over SSH: claude mcp add alfred -s user -- ssh benderman.<tailnet>.ts.net /home/rippere/alfred-v2/.venv/bin/python -m alfred.mcp.meta_server --config /home/rippere/alfred-v2/config-meta.yaml
